limits: This targeted proof does not close SLS-066 or qualify every source/helper failure.
The suspended writer, durable console failure, unknown mutation response and concurrent ownership change are not injected by this campaign.
Normal delete APIs do not offer an atomic client identity comparison.
Deleted provider A records can remain in DNS caches until their expiry; no negative resolver assertion is claimed.
Full-page images extend their viewport; the two mobile viewport artifacts are byte-identical.
The manual and product image are unchanged; this campaign does not claim a new full manual regression.
